description: Store namespaced documents and retrieve evidence by keyword, meaning or both. Start with free capabilities, then configure prompts and upsert records with their source path.
author: Sergey Porfiriev

namespace.help: Required explicit namespace for every data method, prompts and keyword_index; no default or wildcard. UTF-8 NFC, 1..128 bytes, no BOM, NUL or newline.

tableName.help: UTF-8 table name, 1..128 bytes; required for upsert/get/prompts, optional filter for list/delete. A table alone is never sufficient. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Same byte, BOM/NUL/newline and non-blank rules as namespace.

id.help: Exact record ID, 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; strings only, no numeric coercion. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization.

key1.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Empty string is valid; omission in upsert clears it.

key2.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Empty string is valid; omission in upsert clears it.

data.help: UTF-8 source, at most 32768 bytes; no BOM, NUL or invalid encoding. For application/json, supply JSON text. The source cap is an upper bound: whitespace break points can require more than 8 chunks and refuse early. Required unless bigfile is given.

mime-type.help: Content type; HTML excludes script/style, Markdown keeps its source, JSON is canonicalized for chunking.

embeddings.help: Optional array of vectors aligned with deterministic chunks, <=8 vectors and <=8192 total scalars. Each has configured dimensions; finite float32-range numbers only, no booleans. Storage round-trips float32; omission calls Voyage. Get returns reconstructed vectors; list omits them.

limit.help: Page size 1..16; summaries omit data and embeddings and are each <=32 KiB, leaving proxy reply headroom.

cursor.help: Opaque token from list or namespaces with the same method, filters and page size; expires after ten minutes, restart or eviction. At most 128 tokens; raw backend offsets are refused. Paging is not a cross-call snapshot.

action.help: Prompt operation. Requires namespace and tableName. set requires data; get/delete forbid data.

all.help: Required true for any delete without id; a method confirmation flag, never a stored record field. Forbid with id.

query.help: Required search query, 1..1024 UTF-8 bytes. Keyword and hybrid require a searchable word; semantic accepts any non-blank query.

prefix.help: Typed text to complete, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes with at least one word; its last word is completed, and a prefix ending between words has no completion.

source.help: Required source path or URI as provenance data, not a path RAG opens. At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes, NFC, non-blank, no BOM, NUL or newline.

content_hash.help: Optional lower-case SHA256 of exact submitted data UTF-8 bytes; a mismatch refuses before provider work. Computed when omitted. With bigfile it is required and equals the bigfile's sha256.

mode.help: Keyword is free BM25; semantic embeds the query once; hybrid embeds once and fuses dense and BM25 by Qdrant RRF. No silent fallback.

rerank.help: true: one paid Voyage rerank call reorders the query's candidates, at most four times limit, by the rerank_model setting. A failed rerank keeps the unreranked order with reranked:false and a named rerank_failure.

confirm.help: For drop_namespace: must equal the requested namespace exactly. Missing or wrong confirmation refuses without changes.

bigfile.help: A Markdown file of up to 1 MiB in a bigfile this agent may download: record, name, size and sha256 (the SHA-256 of the file's bytes, equal to content_hash, which is then required). Replaces data and embeddings; mime-type is text/markdown. Downloaded and checked before any paid call; less than 120 s of deadline left is refused deadline_too_short.

check.help: get only: true answers whether the stored version is complete, free, without data or vectors; any other value is refused.

upsert.help: Classify and embed one sourced record, then publish its new revision. Provider failure changes no record; a first namespace binding can remain empty. A Markdown file over 32 KiB, up to 1 MiB, comes by bigfile reference instead of data and is chunked by heading.
upsert.returns: Full record JSON, <=256 KiB with reconstructed embeddings and derived classification_ids(label->probability). Omitting key1/key2 clears them. Worst-case escaped-source, label and float32-vector budgets are refused before any paid call.

get.help: Get one record in the required namespace; a missing or foreign-namespace id answers not_found. With check:true, a free completeness check instead: no data or vectors.
get.returns: The full record, at most 256 KiB; a large file's record exceeds this read cap, so use check. With check:true: namespace, tableName, id, source, content_hash, indexed_at and complete (true when the head is committed and every chunk it names exists).

list.help: Browse record summaries in stable order, up to 16 per call; send the returned cursor for the next page.
list.returns: JSON {records:[summaries],cursor:string|null}; <=16 summaries, excluding data and embeddings, each <=32 KiB. Filters do not grant access; no snapshot guarantee across calls.

search.help: Retrieve live evidence in the requested mode and namespace, one best chunk per record. Keyword is the free default; semantic and hybrid use the bound embedding model.
search.returns: JSON with effective mode and live citations: namespace, tableName, id, chunk_index, source, content_hash, excerpt, scores, indexed_at. scores contains bm25 (keyword), dense (semantic) or rrf (hybrid); no component scores are invented. With rerank:true, one paid Voyage rerank call reorders the query's candidates and adds a rerank score; reranked:true says it did, reranked:false with rerank_failure keeps the unreranked order. No generation or historical revision retrieval.

count.help: Count live records matching a filter and how many carry each label; free.
count.returns: JSON {count, labels:{label:records}, labels_truncated}; labels holds at most 64 labels, most frequent first, and labels_truncated:true says more exist. Deleted records are not counted.

similar.help: Find live records whose stored vectors are nearest a given record's, in the same table and namespace; free, nothing is embedded.
similar.returns: JSON {records:[citations]} like search, one best chunk per record, excluding the given record; scores contains similarity. A missing or deleted record answers not_found.

complete.help: Suggest completions of the last word of a typed prefix from the stored text of live records; free. Needs the prefix index keyword_index creates.
complete.returns: JSON {suggestions:[{text, records}], sampled}: the prefix's earlier words plus a completed last word, lower-cased, most records first; the earlier words must appear in the same chunk. It reads at most 64 matching chunks, and sampled:true says more matched. Without the prefix index it is refused as complete_unavailable.

classify.help: Label a text with the table's classification prompts as upsert would, without storing it; one paid #ai call, off unless the classify setting is true.
classify.returns: JSON {labels:{label:probability}, probabilities:{label:probability}}: labels keeps those at or above the table's threshold, at most top_k; probabilities holds every label. With classify off it is refused as classify_unavailable before any call.

keyword_index.help: Create complete's prefix index when the collection lacks it, then build the selected namespace's keyword index. Owner or Maintainers only; both are shared collection settings, created once and safe to repeat.
keyword_index.returns: JSON {status:"ok",indexed:n} when every chunk has its words (n counts this run), or "incomplete: ..." to repeat. If the Qdrant proxy refuses to add the prefix index or the vector, the answer names the owner's one-time command. With keyword_search external it creates the prefix index, then refuses the keyword part.

delete.help: Remove one record, or exactly the namespace-scoped selection you name.
delete.returns: JSON {status:"ok"}, without a count; a missing id answers not_found. id requires tableName and forbids key1/key2/all; otherwise all:true is required. Deletes selected revisions, never prompt KV. A retained tombstone allows explicit cleanup continuation; unknown outcomes never retry themselves.

prompts.help: Read, replace or delete one table's classification prompts; existing records stay as they are.

args.name: data
args.help: For set only: object with labels (1..64 IDs, at most 128 bytes each, mapped to descriptions <=512 bytes), instructions (1..4096 UTF-8 bytes), optional threshold (finite 0..1, default 0.5), top_k (integer 1..64, default 5), summary (<=4096 UTF-8 bytes, stored for R.9). No extra keys; booleans are not numbers.

capabilities.help: Read static app version, methods, modes, limits and configured embedding model, even before configuration. Namespace-free; no storage or paid call and no health claim.

namespaces.help: List known namespace names and exact live-record counts, including empty namespaces. Owner or Maintainers only; no record content. This metadata discovery is namespace-free.
namespaces.returns: JSON {namespaces:[{namespace,count}],cursor:string|null}; a failed count refuses rather than inventing zero.

drop_namespace.help: Remove one namespace's records, prompts and binding. Owner or Maintainers only, with confirm equal to namespace. A partial or uncertain drop stays blocked until an explicitly confirmed continuation; never retried automatically.
drop_namespace.returns: JSON {status:"dropped"|"absent",namespace:string}; another namespace and the shared collection stay unchanged. An absent binding with existing data refuses as legacy_data.

qdrant.help: Complete Qdrant proxy bus name; this app needs its own write grant

voyage.help: Complete embedding proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

ai.help: Complete Decisions proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

collection.help: Owner-created dedicated collection, 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; never auto-created

embedding_model.help: Fixed embedding model ID, verified against collection metadata.embedding_model

dimensions.help: Fixed unnamed Cosine vector size, 1..8192; chunks times dimensions must not exceed 8192 Must also be an output dimension the chosen Voyage model supports; its refusal is not bypassed.

decision_model.help: Model for one Jev Choice call per record

keyword_search.help: Keyword search engine for search: builtin (default) uses the collection's BM25 sparse vector named text; external answers through an engine connected to the agent, and builtin ingest is then off

rerank_model.help: Voyage rerank model for search with rerank:true; empty (default) turns rerank off and such a search is refused as rerank_unavailable

classify.help: true turns on classify, which makes one paid #ai Jev call per request with decision_model; false (default) refuses classify as classify_unavailable
